name: trinity-academy
description: Trinity Academy — Clean Architecture (React + NestJS + MySQL)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n fe,be -c blue,green "npm run dev:fe" "npm run dev:be"
scripts.build: npm run build:fe && npm run build:be
scripts.install:all: cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.db:schema: docker exec -i tac-mysql mysql -uroot -ppassword db_tac < sql/academy-management-schema.sql
scripts.db:seed: docker exec -i tac-mysql mysql -uroot -ppassword db_tac < sql/seed-dev.sql
